svg.title: How a SAP announcement travels
svg.desc: An AoIP sender announces to 239.255.255.255 port 9875. The bridge agent joins that group and catalogues each source, keeping an entry for 300 seconds after its last announcement, then reports its catalogue to the controller over the control channel on TCP 8600. The controller aggregates every agent's catalogue into the dashboard inventory and the address-collision check. On the cloud side a mesh agent joins the same group on ccf0, and because that join is itself a subscription the plant's announcements travel up the fabric without extra configuration; cloud senders announce in the same way, so a fabric-originated stream appears in the plant's source list like any other.
